learning_outcomes.text: Acquisition of basic skills for drawing all the main machine or plant components and understanding drawings already made by others.
Skillful in correlating shape, function and productive processes in developing designs and modeling of the main components in industrial and mechanical machines and plants.

syllabus_topics: Conventional and unconventional tools for design and drafting
Use of standard line types and lettering
Utilization of formats and drawing scale
True shape representation of planar surfaces arbitrarily oriented with respect to orthographic projection planes
Design process, standards, dimensioning and error restriction
Standards in technical design and drafting
First and third angle projections and sectional view standard methods
Design process: assembly and single component drawings
Production process influence on shape and dimensioning of mechanical components
Transfer criteria from functional dimensioning to fabrication dimensioning
Measurement and restriction of component surface roughness
Description and conventional representation of component assemblies devoted to specific tasks
teaching_methods: Display of mechanical actual assemblies and components in classroom
One-on-one explanations and suggestions in laboratories

assessment_methods.method: Individual CAD test (if lacking frequency to CAD laboratories)

assessment_rules: A common exam covers both this module and 'Applicazioni di Disegno Meccanico T'. The exam comprises a written test (compulsory for admission to the speech) and an oral test. To be admitted to the oral test, students must achieve a minimum mean score of 18/30 on the two parts of the written test. Positive results of the written test are valid until the winter session of the next solar year. Lack of frequency to CAD laboratories requires a further individual CAD test. The global score depends on oral test answers, value of laboratory drawings, and written test score.
